# CardSize

`Flare.Components.CardSize`

Overall scale of a FlareCard. Controls the corner radius and the inner gap between stacked anatomy slots, resolving to the active theme's shape scale so the size looks native in every theme.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Sm` | `0` | Small - tighter radius and gap (theme shape-small). |
| `Md` | `1` | Medium - the default radius and gap (theme shape-medium). |
| `Lg` | `2` | Large - rounder radius and roomier gap (theme shape-large). |

## Used by components

- `FlareCard`
